# Project Governance 4.6.1

## Reliable first pushes

The shared Work entry records the task's declared remote integration target as the branch upstream before its first ordinary push. Publication names the feature destination explicitly, so an upstream-oriented Git push default cannot replace the integration branch.

A missing or unavailable comparison base now returns actionable guidance before checks start. The diagnostic does not disclose Git command details or private remote inputs. Existing explicit comparison selection and exact Git-supplied commit checks remain in effect.

## Installation

This maintenance release includes the bundled runtime archive and matching Cowork plugin ZIP. Use the normal pinned-archive installation process and deliberate runtime adoption. Publication does not change existing project pins, task bindings, checkouts or startup authority.

## Qualification and boundaries

The release follows the normal local qualification and manual publication process. GitHub CI is not used. Source tests, installed first-push checks and package proof cover comparison selection, feature destination, private-safe refusal and cleanup. Controlled fixtures do not establish adopter rollout, ordinary task acceptance or benefit claims. Cowork behavior and the existing scanner and execution-budget policies retain their prior implementation; this patch contains no scanner or policy refactor.
